title: Clessidra
description:
In this platform game you will have to overcome challenging puzzles using a weapon capable of rewinding the time of an object.ObjectsDestroy and rebuild objects to overcome obstacles, press buttons or block enemies.
EnemiesHarness the power of your weapon to control enemies and eliminate them.
Skeletons Revive skeletons to use as bait or to press buttons.
TrapsOvercome ingenious traps of various types also thanks to your weapon.
description_short: In this platform game you will have to overcome challenging puzzles using a weapon capable of rewinding the time of an object.
